summary: Enterprise Financial Services Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $175 million public offering of 6.25% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036. The notes bear fixed interest at 6.25% until July 1, 2031, then float at Three-Month Term SOFR plus 232 bps. The issuer may redeem after July 1, 2031 subject to Federal Reserve approval if required. Proceeds to the company are approximately $172.8 million after underwriting discounts. This is a standard debt financing, not a special situation.
